relationships.statement: "End-to-end tests must exercise the egg page through its public contract, verifying the egg emoji and the word 'Eggs' below it as a visitor sees them, driven by a test runner that checks those outcomes; the test runner and its configuration are not chosen here." depends on "When the egg page loads and no further action is taken, a single egg emoji appears centered on the page.".
conditions: End-to-end tests verify the egg emoji as a visitor sees it, which requires the egg emoji to appear centered on the page
